title: Sidechain Sentinel: tenant-aware observability bridge for Dedicated & Private clusters
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight perimeter-sidechain component (Sidechain Sentinel) that sits in Dedicated and Private VPCs/on-prem deployments to normalize and enforce tenant-aware observability behavior. The component will act as an ingress/egress bridge for traces, metrics, and logs: attaching deterministic tenant routing headers, influencing sampling hooks, applying tenant-scoped redaction/masking policies, and assigning shard keys for downstream metric pipelines. Goal is to reduce cross-tenant leakage, preserve latency SLOs, and provide accurate per-tenant latency/error dashboards without requiring heavy client-side changes.
background: We currently see variability in sampled traces and noisy cross-tenant metrics for Dedicated and Private deployments. Customers running private collectors often surface incorrect tenant attribution and uneven metric shard distribution which leads to SLO alert noise and hard-to-debug latency regressions. Past tickets focused on collector fencing and envelope signing; this work complements them by providing a programmable interception layer that standardizes observability signals before they hit the shared pipelines.
goals: Provide deterministic tenant-to-shard mapping for metrics to avoid hot-sharding and ensure evenly distributed ingest
Expose tracing hooks at the perimeter to ensure consistent sampling decisions that honor tenant SLO settings
Enforce log redaction policies per tenant to prevent PII leakage from private clusters
Integrate with Console dashboards so latency and error charts reflect tenant-bounded aggregates
non_goals: Replacing the full on-host collector (we will interoperate, not replace)
Implementing tenant billing or rate limits in this component (handled by routing layer)
Changing hosted API semantics — this is a private/dedicated perimeter feature
acceptance_criteria: Sidechain Sentinel deployed on a Dedicated staging cluster and receives traffic from at least two tenants
Traces arriving at the backend contain canonical tenant_id header and sampling decision origin preserved
Metric shards show even distribution across N shard buckets for tenant traffic in load tests (within 15% variance)
Dashboard in Console displays per-tenant p50/p95/p99 latency and error rates for the test tenants
Log streams from two tenants demonstrate redaction of configured sensitive fields and no cross-tenant leakage in replay tests
tasks: Design API for sentinel: header enrichment and sampling hook protocol (design doc)
Implement gatweay proxy in Go with plugin points for sampling and redaction
Add deterministic shard-key derivation logic and unit tests
Integrate with existing collector envelope signing to validate tenants
Wire metrics into collector pipeline with tenant tags preserved
Create Console dashboard wiring and per-tenant filter controls
Run perf tests (latency under 6ms p95 adding sentinel) and shard-distribution benchmarks
Canary deploy to one Dedicated customer and run two-week validation
decisions: Use a lightweight sidecar-style binary written in Go instead of Lua filters to keep dependency surface small
Adopt deterministic Murmur3-based shard key derived from tenant id + stable salt to ensure stable bucketing during reshard
Sampling hook will prefer 'tenant-declared' decisions when signed; otherwise fallback to sentinel-configured dynamic sampling
Redaction will use a hybrid allowlist+regex approach per tenant to balance performance and correctness
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Spike complete — prototype Go proxy with a header enrichment middleware. Verified header passthrough in local harness.
2026-03-04: Draft design doc uploaded (links below). Architecture review scheduled with Security for 2026-03-09.
2026-03-07: Unit tests for shard key derivation implemented; initial distribution looks even across 1024 buckets in synthetic load.
2026-03-09: Security review feedback: require envelope signature validation before honoring tenant-declared sampling. Addressing in upcoming PR.
2026-03-10: Started Console wiring for per-tenant latency panels; need product input on default aggregation windows
risks_mitigation: Risk: Adding perimeter latency. Mitigation: implement fast-path passthrough when no transformations needed and benchmark p95 target <6ms
Risk: Mis-attribution of metrics during reshard. Mitigation: include migration mode that writes to both old/new shards and provides reconciliation job
Risk: Over-redaction breaking customer logs. Mitigation: customer-configurable redact rules with dry-run mode and samples in Console
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal dedicated cluster only with feature flagged Sentinel (1 week)
Beta: 2 opt-in Dedicated customers, monitor latency/error dashboards and reconcile metric counts (2 weeks)
GA: broader Dedicated and Private onprem offer with documentation and migration guide (post 4 weeks of beta)
test_plan: Unit tests for header enrichment, signing verification, shard derivation
Integration tests with collector staging pipeline using replayed production traffic (sanitized)
Load tests: 100k reqs/s synthetic tenant mix to validate shard balance and tail latency
Security tests: threat model checklist, fuzz redaction rules, validate no PII leaks in sample exports
links: ENG-86209: related tenant sampling hierarchy ticket
notes: Product: need to confirm default per-tenant retention and aggregation windows before Beta
PM requests a lightweight migration CLI for customers to preview which logs would be redacted
